title: Browse and select active same-scope Space assignment destinations from one encrypted local workspace

requirements.invariant: The end-user destination picker observes only active Spaces in one exact Account and exact Project-or-Business-Inventory ItemPlacementScope. It never derives eligibility from an Account-wide array, route state, Item selection or display text, and it performs no assignment or clearing mutation.

Rows expose exactly stable SpaceID, canonical display name and UInt64 revision, ordered by case-insensitive name, exact name and stable SpaceID. Duplicate display names remain valid, and neither display text nor row position is identity.

Waiting for first evidence, incomplete partial, stale, ready nonempty, authoritative empty and bounded read failure are distinct UI states. A represented cached row may be selected offline, but neither represented rows, active local membership nor completeness evidence is current server authorization; zero rows without active scope plus fresh query-specific completeness cannot render authoritative empty.

requirements.section: Clients, Projects, notes, preferences, and reference data
requirements.invariant: One module-internal PowerSync adapter implements SpaceAssignmentDestinationQuerying. The public Account-workspace runtime binds Account implicitly and accepts only ItemPlacementScope; the AppModel and view import Core contracts, not PowerSync, SQL, databases, provider objects or authorization APIs.

A minimal local Space projection, active same-Principal Account-membership sentinel and an owned current-process exact-scope Sync Stream subscription drive the encrypted offline watch. Only that subscription's first-sync completion can establish query completeness. Row and completeness startup order is deterministic; cancellation, request replacement and workspace close unsubscribe and join all observers; restart preserves rows but begins incomplete until a new exact subscription completes.

The local projection is presentation evidence only. Missing/inactive/cross-Principal membership, cross-Account or cross-scope rows, unknown lifecycle, malformed identity/name/revision, duplicate identity, count mismatch and database failure emit no partial mixed-trust snapshot and reveal only stable bounded diagnostics.

items: Reuse SpaceAssignmentDestinationRequest, SpaceAssignmentDestinationSnapshot, SpaceAssignmentDestinationDirectorySnapshot, SpaceAssignmentDestinationQuerying and SpaceAssignmentDestinationFailure without adding a second eligibility, readiness, ordering, revision, scope or selection-row model.

A user may select only a currently represented stable SpaceID. That transient selection is not an Item assignment draft, current-placement claim, authorization grant or mutation receipt; production selection-retention policy is not frozen by this slice.

Add one spike_spaces relation with stable text identity, exact Account, scope_kind constrained to project or business_inventory, nullable project_id constrained present only for Project scope, normalized nonempty display_name, active/archived lifecycle and positive signed-bigint revision. Project scope uses an exact same-Account Project relationship; Business Inventory scope is the owning Account with no synthetic project ID.

Add the deterministic lookup/index path on Account, scope kind, project identity, lifecycle, lower(display_name), exact display_name and stable Space ID. The provider still canonicalizes and validates results; database collation alone is not final presentation authority.

The relation is read-only in this slice. No Space/Item command, trigger, handler, optimistic row, assignment, clearing, archive, create or update mutation exists. The schema migration carries no source data and does not advance migration/cutover authority.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No Space read handler and no Create/Update/Archive/Assign/Clear command or authoritative transaction is added.

items: Revoke all Space-table privileges from PUBLIC, anon and authenticated, then grant authenticated SELECT only. No direct INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, RPC or SECURITY DEFINER execution path exists for this read slice.

Enable RLS and permit SELECT only when the row lifecycle is active and the authenticated Principal has active membership in the row's exact Account. Same-Account restricted members retain this non-financial active Space-directory read; anonymous, revoked, cross-Account and archived rows are non-enumerable.

The policy uses the indexed active-membership predicate with stable auth evaluation and cannot accept caller-supplied route or local scope evidence as authorization. Local filtering remains defense-in-depth and presentation shaping, not a substitute for RLS/Sync authorization.

Add two on-demand active-Space streams carrying only stable Space ID, Account, scope kind/project identity, display name, lifecycle and revision. Project scope is parameterized by stable ProjectID; Business Inventory is parameterized by stable AccountID. Each client parameter narrows an authenticated active-membership join. Neither stream downloads unrelated Project Spaces, Item data or archived Spaces or exposes an upload path.

The provider owns the exact typed-scope subscription, waits for that subscription's first sync before emitting complete, and unsubscribes during request replacement, consumer cancellation and runtime close. Local tests inject a reciprocal subscription source deterministically; a real authenticated Sync authorization/completeness/eviction round-trip remains planned and is required before A-004 or hosted readiness advances.

Revocation or lifecycle change must remove prior destination entitlement from the synchronized local working set; local membership loss clears prior presentation immediately even before connected eviction proof.

Mirror the server spike_spaces read relation in the local PowerSync schema with stable row identity, exact Account, typed placement-scope kind/identity, display name, lifecycle and revision plus one Account/scope lookup index. Encrypted tests seed synthetic rows; production-shaped rows are owned by the exact Space Sync Stream and no upload path exists.

Use a sentinel-preserving query over the active exact Principal/Account membership plus exact Account/scope Space rows, then canonicalize through the verified Core directory. Inactive, foreign, malformed and duplicate evidence fails atomically.

Combine independent row evidence and exact-scope subscription first-sync evidence only after both provide initial evidence. Generic connection or database sync status cannot prove completeness. Active scope plus completed exact subscription may render ready or authoritative empty; otherwise rows remain honest partial/stale evidence.

The runtime owns one provider, every watch uses its existing close-aware stream lease, and provider/request cancellation unsubscribes and drains row/completeness observers before structured database close. Encrypted restart preserves rows while completeness resets.

The AppModel switches exact requests generation-safely, exposes tested waiting/partial/stale/ready/authoritative-empty/bounded-failure presentation, and accepts only a represented stable SpaceID as transient selection without inferring hidden rows, current authorization or final production selection-retention policy.

verification.owner: Supabase Postgres security, indexing and collation review
verification.expected: Review confirms least-privilege SELECT-only grants/RLS, indexed membership and Account/scope/order paths, exact conditional Project relationship, no write surface, stable auth evaluation and no assumption that database collation replaces Core canonical ordering.

Cross-Account calls refuse before observation; missing/inactive/cross-Principal membership clears prior rows and cannot yield false empty; cross-scope/inactive/malformed/duplicate/overflow rows and database failure yield no mixed snapshot; exact Project/Inventory subscriptions are owned, unsubscribed and joined on consumer cancellation, request replacement and runtime close with no late emission.

Executable presenter/AppModel tests cover every waiting/partial/stale/ready/authoritative-empty/failure state, accept selection only by a represented stable SpaceID, ignore late prior-request events, and expose no Item/Assign/Clear/Space mutation or MCP boundary without freezing unspecified production selection-retention policy.

An isolated user can open one typed Project or Inventory destination picker, see honest waiting/partial/stale/ready/empty/failure presentation, browse deterministically ordered active same-scope rows offline and select a represented stable SpaceID without selecting an Item or issuing a mutation.

The build-only isolated picker compiles as a thin renderer over the presenter states and represented stable-ID action proven in TEST-004; source-boundary checks prove no independent filtering/state semantics, production route, raw editor, Item selection, Assign/Clear action, Space mutation or MCP surface. Compilation is not treated as behavioral rendering proof.

The exact future implementation checkpoint passes conversion controls, focused and complete nonparallel target tests, source/build-boundary checks and both staging builds with clean generated artifacts, no hosted or production access and A-003/A-004 unchanged.

notes: Comment-only READY package for the next bounded end-user Space workflow. The six claimed leaves contain no executable declarations. The Postgres migration filename was produced by pinned Supabase CLI 2.116.0 and removed so it remains absent-at-READY. Future implementation must create and register that exact migration, runnable pgTAP and disposable local Data API runner, and may change only the frozen discovery/package/workflow, exact-scope Space Sync Streams, local-schema/runtime/staging/checker touchpoints; a synchronized implementation checkpoint must classify and claim every newly discovered physical leaf before status can advance. Project and Business Inventory use separate typed on-demand subscriptions, and only exact subscription first-sync evidence can establish completeness. The package consumes the already-verified destination contract rather than reinterpreting EVID-SPACE-ASSIGNMENT-DESTINATION-001. O-037 does not block this read because RLS, Data API and Sync all exclude archived rows and Space archive behavior is otherwise excluded. There is no raw free-text submission: the read path only validates representable already-materialized canonical SpaceDisplayName values. User selection is limited to represented stable IDs, but unspecified production selection-retention policy is not frozen. TQUERY-A95F4BE0B9D8/TACCESS-14FBA8E573D3 have no unresolved logical-authority axis. A-003/A-004 remain proposed because this READY package executes nothing and provides no hosted/current-authorization proof; later isolated schema/RLS/Sync/local-provider implementation remains spike evidence until the complete physical gate. No Space or Item mutation, Item selection, MCP, source-data migration, hosted call, production access, Firebase change, release or cutover is authorized.
